description: Delete a SimplifyQA sprint (Sprints → Delete). TWO-STEP: call with `sprintId` (id, code like SP-64, or exact name) and no `confirm` to PREVIEW — it lists everything still linked (stories, defects, tasks, execution plans, pipelines, schedules) and deletes nothing. Show that to the user, and call again with `confirm:true` ONLY after the user explicitly says to delete. A sprint that anything still uses is refused even with confirm. Only an admin user can delete a sprint.

confirm.description: true on the SECOND call, only after the user explicitly said to delete.

sprintId.description: Sprint id, code (SP-64) or exact name.
